Settings / Backup

Business details, bank details, UPI QR & data safety

UPI QR is generated from your UPI ID and the exact invoice amount. Bank details are printed on invoices when entered. Perfume sales can automatically consume Attar + Alcohol from inventory using the recipe saved on each perfume.

Business Details

Bank & UPI Payment Details

QR uses UPI ID + invoice amount. If UPI ID is blank, the QR is not shown.

Import Products

Cloud Backend (Google Sheet as Database)

Paste your deployed Apps Script Web App URL here. Every time data is saved, everything (products, sales, purchases, customers, suppliers, expenses, payments, returns, settings) is automatically pushed to your Google Sheet as a live cloud copy. Use "Pull Latest from Cloud" on any other device to bring it up to date with the cloud.
